howToPlay: Dash toward enemies with low health or those who are isolated to secure takedowns. Utilize the longer dash provided by your mechanics to close gaps and unleash powerful strikes with your shovel. Heal your health using your Super or the Creepy Harvest Star Power to stay in the fight longer.
gears: Equip SPEED and DAMAGE to maximize mobility and combat effectiveness. The BAT STORM gear is also highly recommended to enhance your supernatural abilities.
trait: This assassin is perfect for players who enjoy high-mobility gameplay and aggressive opportunism.
